scope: Shorter problem copy, calmer desktop fan, upright mobile reading holds, earlier front reveal, balanced photo rendering, header clearance and independently pinned short-phone card stage.

productionBuild.note: Used the existing documented Windows Webpack fallback. Default build script unchanged.

visualReview.method: Rendered Chrome screenshots inspected directly: desktop joined landscape, split and reading fan; tablet and phone reading holds; short-phone heading with returning navigation, card-only pin and CTA release; existing hero renders.
visualReview.coverageLimit: Chrome viewport emulation, not real-device Safari coverage or proof of photographic realism.

palette: Core brand tokens retained: Deep Teal, Fog, restrained mint/amber emphasis and existing teal-to-blue action gradient. Refinements use spacing, photo exposure and a shorter reading fade.
media: Accepted graduate-v1, professional-v2, freelancer-v1 and teal-landscape-v1 source files retained. No new media generation or credits used.
deployment: Not deployed. Local development server at http://127.0.0.1:3000/.
